releases.title: v0.9.1 — Hotfix tracker connectivity
releases.notes:
## Hotline Modern v0.9.1 — Hotfix

### Corrections critiques
- **Tracker connectivity** : remplace `localhost` par `127.0.0.1` pour éviter les problèmes de résolution DNS IPv6
- **Bootstrap config** : valide la joignabilité d'un tunnel avant de le mettre en cache (timeout 3s)
- **URLs périmées** : nettoyage automatique des tunnels trycloudflare morts au démarrage
- **Tracker local préservé** : ne supprime jamais `localhost:9998` quand on ajoute un tunnel
- **public-config.json** : vidé pour ne plus pointer vers un tunnel mort

releases.title: v1.2.0 — E2E Encryption, Server Discovery, Read Receipts
releases.notes:
## What's New

### Server Discovery (Tracker)
- **Standalone tracker binary** — decentralized server directory with heartbeat/TTL
- **Server browser** in the connect dialog — browse, search, and quick-connect to servers
- **Multi-tracker support** — fetch from multiple trackers with deduplication

### End-to-End Encryption (DMs)
- **Real NaCl box encryption** (Curve25519 / XSalsa20-Poly1305) for direct messages
- Server never sees plaintext — stores `[encrypted]` in database
- Green shield indicator shows encryption status in DM header
- Backward compatible with older clients

### Read Receipts
- See who has read your messages (up to 5 names displayed)
- Automatic read receipt sending when at bottom of chat

### Voice Messages
- Dedicated audio player rendering for voice recordings
- `msgType` field distinguishes voice from text messages
- Works in threads too

### Desktop Notifications
- Web Notification API with 500ms throttle and mute support

### Server Agreement
- Configurable agreement text shown on connect (accept/decline)

### Other Improvements
- Join/leave system messages (centered, italic)
- Full French + English i18n coverage
- Security hardening (CORS fixes, body size limits, input validation)
- 137 tests passing

## Downloads
- **Hotline-Modern-Setup.exe** — Windows installer (NSIS)
- **Hotline-Modern.msi** — Windows installer (MSI)
- **Hotline-Modern-Portable.exe** — Windows portable (no install)
- **Hotline-Modern.apk** — Android app
- **hotline-server.exe** — Chat server
- **hotline-tracker.exe** — Server discovery tracker

releases.title: Hotline Modern v1.0.0
releases.notes:
# 🚀 Hotline Modern v1.0.0

Modern reinvention of [Hotline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hotline_Communications) (1997) — decentralized chat and file sharing with self-hosted servers.

## Highlights

- **Go server** with embedded SQLite — zero external dependencies
- **React/Tauri client** — lightweight, native, modern
- **Ed25519 identity** — portable across servers, no central accounts
- **Real-time chat** — channels, DMs, typing indicators, reactions, threads
- **File sharing** — drag & drop upload, file browser, inline previews
- **Moderation** — 4-tier roles, kick/ban, admin panel
- **Rich UX** — dark/light themes, compact mode, keyboard shortcuts, i18n (EN/FR)
- **Image lightbox** — zoom, rotate, download
- **Message search** — full-text across channels with highlights
- **Desktop notifications** — sound, tab badges, toast alerts

## Quick Start

```bash
# Server
cd server && go build -o hotline-server ./cmd/hotline-server/ && ./hotline-server

# Client
cd client && npm install && npm run dev
```

## Full Feature List

See [README.md](https://github.com/Oli97430/hotline-modern#features) for the complete feature breakdown.
